title: Fairly Dividing a Discovery Campaign's Outcome Among Its Members, Meetings, and Borrowed Knowledge
description: Figure scripts, result files, producing code and inputs for the paper "Fairly Dividing a Discovery Campaign's Outcome Among Its Members, Meetings, and Borrowed Knowledge" (Transactions on Machine Learning Research). Taylor D. Sparks acknowledges support from the Army Research Office Materials Design, under Contract No. W911NF-23-1-0333.
notes: Code (Python, shell and SLURM scripts) is released under the MIT License (LICENSE). Data, result files and figures are released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence (LICENSE-CC-BY-4.0.txt). The archived third-party datasets (Materials Project, JARVIS-DFT, SNUMAT, the Zhuo et al. experimental compilation) keep their own terms; their sources are cited in the paper.
